wizard_login.title: Wizard: Quick Setup
wizard_login.description:
## 🚀 Quick & Easy Credential Extraction

**Recommended options (reliable):**

### Option A: Network Header (Recommended)

1. Open [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) in a **private/incognito window**
2. **Sign in** with your Google account
3. Open **Developer Tools** → **Network** tab → enable **Preserve log**
4. Filter for `issueToken` and copy the full **Request URL**
5. Filter for `oauth2/iframe`, open the latest request, and copy the full **Cookie** header value

**Important:** Copy the **Cookie header** from the `oauth2/iframe` request, **not** `document.cookie`.

### Option B: Playwright Wizard (Recommended)

Run the helper script from the repo:

`python3 scripts/nest_protect_cookie_wizard.py`

It guides you through the same flow and copies the **Issue Token URL** and **Cookie header** for you.

### Not recommended: Console snippets

Console snippets are **unreliable** and often return incomplete cookies. Use the Network-Header method or the Playwright wizard instead.

### Paste Below

**💡 Tip:** You can paste both values into the first field separated by a line break, and they will be automatically split into the correct fields.

Paste the values in the fields below:
- **Issue Token URL**: the full request URL from `issueToken`
- **Cookies**: the full **Cookie** header value from `oauth2/iframe`

data_description.issue_token: Paste from clipboard (starts with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc). You can paste both token and cookies here separated by a newline.
data_description.cookies: Paste from clipboard (leave empty if already pasted above with token)

account_link.title: Connect Your Nest Account
account_link.description:
Follow these steps to get your credentials:

1. Open an **Incognito/Private** browser window
2. Enable **third-party cookies** in browser settings
3. Go to [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) and sign in with Google
4. Open **Developer Tools** (F12) → **Network** tab → Check **Preserve Log**
5. In the filter box, type `issueToken` and copy the full **Request URL**
6. In the filter box, type `oauth2/iframe`, click the last request, and copy the entire **Cookie** header value

⚠️ Do not log out of home.nest.com after copying credentials

data_description.cookies: Complete cookie string from the oauth2/iframe request headers
